title: ranunculus inaequalidens
intro: Ranunculus inaequalidens, commonly known as Inequi Ranunculus or Inequi Buttercup, is a plant species belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may contribute to its potential in wound healing and antiseptic applications. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus inaequalidens include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
